Your KBuddy order is paid and hasn't shipped yet, Mike. The GekkoScience KBuddy (15 to 18 TH/s) ships December 1, 2026, and the Harlo OS Diagnostics add-on goes out in the same box.

You can follow that batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Anything else you want me to check?
Why is the kbuddy no longer listed on the website?

Handed to the team · Don't know why the KBuddy listing was unpublished; won't guess.

The listing is off the storefront at the moment, so it isn't buyable. I don't want to guess at the reason, so I've asked the team and someone will come back on it.

Your order isn't affected. The KBuddy is paid, held for you, and still ships December 1.

Stay in the chat if you can, one of them will jump in here. If you step away, the answer comes to your email.
Okay thanks, I was just concerned that it was no longer listed.
Used the chat-interview skill
Ran dossier.py (chat-interview skill)

Totally fair, nothing's changed on your side. It's paid, reserved, and ships December 1.

Before you go, one thing: you looked at a fair few miners before settling on the KBuddy. What made it the one?

It was the best "next step" for my solo mining journey. I wasn't quite willing to pull the trigger on a 30-50TH machine. I currently just have a Nerdaxe Gamma 1.2TH which was my first test and try at mining. I recognize solo mining is lottery mining so I wasn't quite willing to drop thousands on it right now, but a few hundred (plus $20 a month electricity) is doable for a very small but actual shot at mining a block before the halving ( around 1 in 1000 chance by then). Maybe in the next 6 months to a year I'll buy more if I have the money.

That's a clear way to think about it, and the honest one.

What would have to change for you to step up to a 30 to 50 TH machine later, the price, the power draw, or something else?
Efficiency and price for the miner.

Makes sense.

Last one: what number would actually do it for you, a price per TH, or a watts-per-TH figure you'd want to see first?
Anything less than $30/TH and 13w/TH is always great for now.

That's a useful marker, thanks Mike. I'll pass it on to the team.

Your KBuddy is set for December 1, and you'll hear back on the listing question.
